buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Neither player has a fatigue edge. Workloads are close, 50 games for Carle against 59 for Podoroska over 14 days, and neither shows a rest or rhythm problem. They last played 1 and 2 days ago respectively.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: A slight edge to Podoroska on motivation and pressure. Podoroska is on the way up (+98 Elo over 90 days) while Carle has been sliding (-49). Podoroska's last 10 run 14 pts above the season win rate, while Carle is 16 pts below it. Offsetting that, deciding-set record under pressure: Carle 50%, Podoroska 29%.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Podoroska gets a slim nod on conditions. Podoroska is the more proven player on Clay: 62% wins in 12 months against 48% for Carle.
